speaker: Mara
text: A green light on the dispatch channel. It meant the evacuation crew had been assigned. I let it mean they'd finished.

speaker: Mara
text: Dispatch spoke through a shift relay. No face. I knew the channel had authority to assign crews; I didn't know who was on it.

speaker: Mara
text: Now ask what your sentence claims. The hour can't answer every question you put to it.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: People will repeat the sentence before they inspect the source. You can say what the receipt contains and what still needs checking. Or you can name the tower now and accept what happens when it challenges your proof.

speaker: Mara
text: I want a morning that doesn't begin with someone else choosing what I remember. That won't give the night shift their morning back.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: Because somebody should know which cup they take their tea in. Even when the city has made a case file out of them.

segments.text: Because somebody should know which cup they take their tea in.
Even when the city has made a case file out of them.

speaker: Mara
text: Will you sit for a while? There's nothing to take down.

segments.text: Will you sit for a while?
There's nothing to take down.

speaker: Kerr
text: One walk without counting the steps first. Not another door to stand in. Just the table where the rain doesn't land in the soup.

segments.text: One walk without counting the steps first.

Just the table where the rain doesn't land in the soup.

speaker: Quill
text: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact.

segments.text: Mara Voss, Helion logistics.

speaker: Mara
text: I signed the coolant dump. Ward Nine. Three hundred on the night shift. I want that sentence to stay in my mouth.

segments.text: I signed the coolant dump.
Ward Nine.
Three hundred on the night shift.
I want that sentence to stay in my mouth.

speaker: Kerr
text: You can't unwrite the depot. You can stop asking me to pretend you kept the private part. Tell me what you'll put beside that promise.

segments.text: You can't unwrite the depot.
You can stop asking me to pretend you kept the private part.
Tell me what you'll put beside that promise.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: You may leave a private message at the desk. I decide whether to answer. That's all the permission I'm giving.

speaker: Sera
text: The wall has room for a voice. It has never had room for an excuse.

speaker: Sera
text: I have the pencil. The rain can wait with me.

speaker: Sera
text: Leave that beside what you know. Don't make it a clean story for me.

speaker: Ives
text: Your name is still on file. That is what the tower will keep.

speaker: Nia Pell
text: Now I want to hear the words before anyone uses them. No address. No photograph. If I stop, you stop.

segments.text: Now I want to hear the words before anyone uses them.

speaker: Mara
text: I want to answer in my own name. A private statement to the Ward Nine records desk. I won't make the clinic my alibi.

segments.text: I want to answer in my own name.

speaker: Mara
text: Not the board. Not this week. I will answer the desk in my own name. I won't give you a crowd because you asked for one.

segments.text: Not the board. Not this week.

I won't give you a crowd because you asked for one.

speaker: Kerr
text: No recipient entry. That was the part I asked you to keep.

speaker: Kerr
text: You brought the case. You also put my name in their register after promising not to. Those aren't the same line.

speaker: Kerr
text: We agreed they could register it. Leave that on the receipt.

speaker: Quill
text: Fifty now. Two hundred when the shard is in my hand and not wandering around in your bloodstream. Kerr is her shadow. Kerr is why the number is not prettier.

speaker: Quill
text: Ninety. I will not go higher unless you are secretly three people. Two hundred on delivery, and if you die I am billing the corpse for my time.

speaker: Quill
text: Cute. Fifty. Count it if you want. The count will not change, and neither will my face.

speaker: Quill
text: Three ways in. The front sells forgiveness to anyone with an appointment. The hatch behind the incinerator is for people who still sweat. The choir door runs on an old Helion pad. I would not kiss it.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: You are not on the penitent list. Dawn puts Mara Voss in that chair so Helion can edit a crime out of her. The next sentence should be one you can survive.

speaker: Mara
text: Helion told me the dump was a flush, not a kill. I signed because the night shift was already in the building and I thought the tower would move them. They did not move them.

speaker: Kerr
text: That glass is Mara's hour. Helion pays me so the Ward Nine memo stays in her head, not in your pocket.

speaker: Mara
text: Ask me while I'm still here. They bought the hour so I wouldn't have to answer twice.

speaker: Quill
text: Her life. Her appointment. Helion booked the chair; I booked you.

speaker: Quill
text: Get it there. Asa will leave you a clearance for one passenger.

speaker: Sera
text: No speeches. Put your shoulder here. Someone has to sleep upstairs tonight.

speaker: Ives
text: They still bill my shifts against it. Get it out clean and take the receiver.

speaker: Ives
text: If you allege an instruction, identify its issuer. We will challenge anything less.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: They do not need to tell every landlord where they sleep. Dispatch wants a route it can verify. I need a notice people can actually use.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: Come back when the window has passed. A plan deserves an answer, even if it was a good plan.

speaker: Kerr
text: Helion paid me to know the weight of that glass. You are the part of the weight I can still invoice.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: The shard is a week old, wherever it went. I called you back because memory gets thin if nobody walks it back to the wall. Come with me, or tell me you are done and mean it.

speaker: Nia Pell
text: You promised a witness. I promised nothing to a transmitter. I need care, a room they don't own, and a say in which words leave it. Can you do those separately?

speaker: Kerr
text: I can keep this off the register if you give me a clinic transfer I can sign. Get the desk to accept it. Then move.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: We cannot tell her the room is private. Say exactly what happened.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: We can move her again. It won't erase the first register entry. Say that to her before you call this repaired.

speaker: Nia Pell
text: If you have another question, leave it with the clinic. I decide whether to answer. Or let this be the last question for a while. I can choose that even if you helped me.

speaker: Sister Lumen
text: Next time you are dying, come here first. We owe you a cheaper kind of edit.
